method: Reconstruct training features from saved source receipts, original permitted arrays and candidate seeds; NumPy matrix_rank without refitting or scoring.

scaling_audit.implication: Truth dictionaries stay outside fitting, but their extrema indirectly influence public anchors. The fixture is transductive and cannot establish independently isolated real-control evaluation. No closed outcome was changed or rerun.

limitation: The 60 pair labels come from four sets of six scores, at most 20 independent within-context contrasts. Reversed training rows add no independent feedback. Rank deficiency is a diagnostic, not proof that it caused poor held-bundle prediction.
